short_text_gate: Expected exact answers and repeated greedy outputs must agree; malformed, empty, timeout or truncated reasoning-only output fails. Six raw smoke outputs are not a numerical qualification.
hybrid_state_gate: Check recurrent/conv plus main KV/indexer/scales/compressor tail at same token position before/after continuation, cancellation/reuse and PD; whole-model output gate also required.
scope_note: Initial bounded tolerances for correctness investigations; no runtime evidence yet. Do not loosen after seeing failures without a versioned rationale.
